correctness.rationale: For the centered weighted graphical zonotope, the support function is exactly one half of the weighted edge total variation. Central symmetry shows an optimal inscribed Euclidean ball can be centered at the origin. A mean-zero layer-cake representation plus discrete coarea and the Euclidean triangle inequality yields the lower bound by the minimum centered cut quotient, and every cut quotient is realized by its centered indicator. Exact rational enumeration over all connected labeled graphs on 2 through 5 vertices with two positive weightings each corroborates the identities without being used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem determines an intrinsic metric invariant for every connected positively weighted graphical zonotope by a natural graph bottleneck optimization.
